S1.why: Everyday मोफत, not the formal विनामूल्य; a label needs only the count and the word. Same in mr-IN: Marathi is written the same way across India and both vocab files are identical.

S2.why: An invitation to carry on, polite imperative राहा for तुम्ही; no warning or limit word, 12 characters.

S3.s: तुमच्या %lld मोफत जागा भरल्या आहेत. त्यांतले कटलिंग मोफतच राहतील आणि नेहमीसारखे चालतील.
S3.back: Your 5 free places filled have. Those-in-them cutlings free-only will-stay and as-always will-run.
S3.why: The tiles are slots, so used-up becomes 'places filled' (जागा, feminine); future tense keeps कटलिंग free of gender agreement.

S4.s: तुम्ही %lld कटलिंग मोफत जतन करू शकता.
S4.why: Plain statement in तुम्ही with the vocab item word कटलिंग, which stays the same in the plural.

S5.why: Marathi says the total first ('5 पैकी 3'), so positional placeholders; same 'free places' as S3.

S6.why: Noun phrase like a heading; जागा is the same room word the free slots use.

S7.s: %@ पर्यंत मजकूर कटलिंग आणि %lld पर्यंत चित्रे जतन करता येतील.
S7.back: 5,000 up-to text cutlings and 500 up-to images save can-will.
S7.why: मजकूर कटलिंग and चित्रे straight from the vocab; impersonal 'करता येतील' avoids agreement and reads as a capability.

S8.why: Marathi lists with a comma and आणि before the last; device names stay Latin as the vocab writes Mac.

S9.s: एकच खरेदी तिन्हींवर चालते, तुमच्या Apple Account मधून.
S9.back: One purchase all-three-on works, your Apple Account through.
S9.why: तिन्हींवर points back at S8 so the devices are not named twice; Apple Account kept Latin as in the vocab.

S10.why: The spoken obligative भरायचे is how a Marathi speaker says 'you pay just once'; एकदाच carries the 'only once'.

S11.s: सदस्यता नाही, जाहिराती नाहीत, खाते उघडायची गरज नाही.
S11.back: Subscription not, advertisements are-not, account to-open need not.
S11.why: Three plain negations; 'no need to open an account' is the native way to say no sign-up, and खाते is kept apart from Apple Account.

S12.why: iOS has no Marathi system UI, so this follows the wording Marathi store apps use for Restore Purchases.

S13.why: Present continuous of the S12 verb, with the single ellipsis character.

S14.why: 'मध्ये' after a price is the Marathi 'for'; एकदाच makes it clear the price is paid one time.

S15.why: The S14 action with no price; अनलॉक is the word Marathi phone users already see.

S16.why: The everyday polite 'not now': putting it off, not a refusal.

S17.why: The plain verb for shutting a window or sheet.

S18.why: सारे with the emphatic -च gives the warm, slightly proud 'all of it is yours'; 15 characters.

S19.s: खरेदीबद्दल धन्यवाद. यातून कटलिंग आणि ते एकट्याने बनवणाऱ्याला आधार मिळतो.
S19.back: Purchase-about thanks. This-from Cutling and it alone-by maker-to support gets.
S19.why: Thanks first, then what the money does; 'एकट्याने बनवणारा' names the one maker without a job title.

S20.s: पुन्हा स्वागत आहे. तुमची आधीची खरेदी परत मिळाली.
S20.back: Again welcome is. Your earlier purchase back got.
S20.why: A returning person's greeting, then the fact; खरेदी is feminine so तुमची, आधीची, मिळाली agree.

S21.why: Same words as S5 so the voice matches the screen; no full stop for VoiceOver.

S22.why: कटलिंग does not change for 1, 2, 5 or 21 and the phrase has no verb, so no plural form is needed.

S23.s: कटलिंग अनलॉक झाले. आता %@ कटलिंगसाठी जागा आहे.
S23.back: Cutling unlocked became. Now 5,000 cutlings-for room is.
S23.why: The app name takes neuter singular झाले, as Marathi treats an app; second sentence reuses S6.

S24.why: States what happened with no actor, so nobody is blamed.

S25.s: App Store शी आत्ता संपर्क होत नाही. थोड्या वेळाने पुन्हा प्रयत्न करा.
S25.back: App Store with right-now contact happening not. Little time-after again try do.
S25.why: Names the cause, then the way out; आत्ता keeps it temporary.

S26.s: App Store ने ही खरेदी निश्चित केली नाही.
S26.back: App Store by this purchase confirmed did not.
S26.why: The App Store is the subject, so the fault sits there, not with the person.

S27.s: या उपकरणावर साइन इन केलेल्या Apple Account मध्ये कटलिंगची आधीची खरेदी नाही.
S27.back: This device-on signed in Apple Account in Cutling's earlier purchase is-not.
S27.why: Reuses the vocab's 'उपकरणावर साइन इन केलेल्या' and 'Apple Account मध्ये' phrasing.

S28.s: मोफत आवृत्तीत %lld कटलिंग जतन करता येतात. कटलिंग एकदा अनलॉक केल्यावर हवे तितके जतन करा.
S28.back: Free version-in 5 cutlings save can-be. Cutling once unlock after as-many-as wanted save do.
S28.why: 'मोफत आवृत्ती' keeps the app name from colliding with the item word in the first sentence; हवे तितके is the native 'as many as you like'.

S29.why: Compact total-first count under the title कटलिंग, which supplies the noun.

K1.s: %lld मोफत जागा भरल्या. अनलॉकसाठी टॅप करा
K1.back: 5 free places filled. Unlock-for tap do
K1.why: Same 'free places filled' as S3; about 26 aksharas with the number, inside 30.

M1.why: Verb-led command in the polite imperative, as Marathi menu commands read.

M2.why: M1 with the ellipsis character because it opens a window.

M3.why: The same 'free places' the sheet uses, as a row label.

M4.why: The compact Marathi number pair, total first, positional placeholders.

M5.why: Same form as S23's first sentence.

M6.s: एकाच खरेदीत iPhone, iPad आणि Mac वर कटलिंग अनलॉक होते.
M6.back: One-only purchase-in iPhone, iPad and Mac on Cutling unlocked becomes.
M6.why: S8's list reused; the habitual होते states a fact, not a pitch.

M7.s: या Apple Account सह iPhone, iPad आणि Mac वर कटलिंग अनलॉक आहे.
M7.back: This Apple Account with iPhone, iPad and Mac on Cutling unlocked is.
M7.why: Present state with आहे; Apple Account stays Latin.

M8.s: कटलिंग मोफत होण्याआधीच तुम्ही ते घेतले होते, म्हणून ते अनलॉकच राहील. साथ दिल्याबद्दल धन्यवाद.
M8.back: Cutling free becoming-before-already you it bought had, so it unlocked-only will-stay. Support given-for thanks.
M8.why: Pluperfect घेतले होते for the earlier purchase; 'साथ दिल्याबद्दल' thanks them for standing by the app.
